names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 25 iunie, «Sfântul Cuvios Dionisie»; the epithet in the English form is from his life, which sets his whole labour on the Holy Mountain.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 25 Ιουνίου, «Όσιος Διονύσιος κτήτορας της Μονής Τιμίου Προδρόμου Αγίου Όρους», with the rank word and the foundation left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 25. јун ст. ст., „Преподобни Дионисије“ — Преподобни is the rank, which `types` already carries, and what is left is a bare forename with no see, no place and no by-name: **the heading is two words long and one of them is the rank.** The «of Athos» of the display name is the corpus’s own and §10 reserves it, and Дионисијат and Атон are in the body and were never candidates for the form. **THE FOLD IS FORCED AND IS MEASURED BOTH WAYS.** `foldchk.py` returns four other holders of the exact string «Дионисије» — `dionysius-companion-of-lucillian`, `dionysius-companion-of-quadratus`, `dionysius-companion-of-socrates` and `dionysius-of-lampsacus`, every one of them an `sr` form — and `.tmp/sr-foldpred.mjs` returns the same four for the gate’s folded key, so this folder is the fifth. A `READ_FOLDS` key is added in the same commit, writing the row and registering the fold being two acts.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 25 iunie — «Sfântul Cuvios Dionisie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 25ης Ιουνίου — «Όσιος Διονύσιος κτήτορας της Μονής Τιμίου Προδρόμου Αγίου Όρους»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the birthplace settles the identity: saint.gr makes him born «στο χωριό Κορησσό της Καστοριάς», the Korison of Kastoria the folder's life already names. The page adds the dating the Romanian source leaves out — his brother Theodosius made metropolitan of Trebizond under Alexius III Comnenus (1350–1390), the monastery approved in 1375 — so no `dates` object is proposed, because those years come from this second source alone. Two of the three hymns on the page are a mis-hang and are not taken: the second apolytikion, Ἦχος δ’ Ταχύ προκατάλαβε, and the kontakion, Ἦχος γ’ Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον, both address «Προφῆτα καὶ Πρόδρομε» and are the Forerunner's, the monastery's patron, not his. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 08.07.2026 (25. јун ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Дионисије“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. The Julian 25 June is the same menologion number this folder’s other venerated rows carry, so there is no second day and no §4 note is owed; the Russian row stays `undocumented`. **THREE YEARS AND AN AGE IN ONE ENTRY, AND `dates` STAYS NULL.** The folder holds no date and gains none. „Године 1380. основа Дионисије обитељ светог Јована Претече.“ — in the year **1380** Dionysius founded the house of Saint John the Forerunner — is **a year of a foundation and not of a person**, the same class as a translation of relics or a relic-finding, and it is written nowhere. „Но када једном разбојници морски опљачкаше обитељ, оде Дионисије поново у Трапезунт, и тамо сконча живот, у седамдесет другој години свога живота.“ ends his life at Trebizond у седамдесет другој години, **in his seventy-second year**, which is **an age and a lifespan and is refused twice over** — and which agrees exactly with the Romanian account in this folder’s own prose, «having lived in this world seventy-two years». Two books agreeing on an age still give no year, and **nothing is derived by arithmetic from an age and a reign**. The emperor Алексије Комнен is no source for a year either. **AND THE TWO BOOKS DISAGREE ABOUT THE FOUNDATION BY FIVE YEARS, WHICH CHANGES NOTHING BECAUSE NEITHER YEAR IS HIS.** saint.gr, in this folder’s prose, has «In 1375, the page says, Alexius III approved the raising of the monastery»; this book has 1380 for the founding. An approval and a founding are not even the same event. Both are in the prose and neither is in a field. **RULING 3, AND THE DAY LIST ITSELF IS THE TRAP.** „Његов старији брат Теодосије удаљи се у Свету Гору, где временом постане игуманом манастира Филотеја.“ and „По Промислу Божјем Теодосије, бавећи се једном манастирским послом у Цариграду, би изабран и посвећен за митрополита у Трапезунт.“ make his elder brother Теодосије abbot of Philotheou and then, by the Providence of God while he was on monastery business in Constantinople, chosen and consecrated metropolitan of Trebizond. **The corpus keeps a `theodosius-25-june` on this very menologion number** — it is on the day list this reading started from — **and he is a `martyr` who died in 1419 by saint.gr’s own heading, and is emphatically not this man.** An identification off a bare forename, or off a name in another man’s life, is not an identification, and sharing a day is not a relation. So the brother gets no row and no folder; he is named here, and he is named in this folder’s existing prose off both other books, which is why the paragraph below may keep him. **WHAT THIS BOOK HAS THAT NEITHER OTHER DOES.** „Родом из Корице у Албанији.“ — he was from **Korica in Albania**, where doxologia makes him of a village called Korison on the borders of Kastoria and saint.gr of Korisso of Kastoria: **a third placing of one birthplace**, and no `locations` is written on any of the three. „Дионисију пак почне се јављати нека чудна светлост сваке ноћи на оном месту, где он доцније подигне обитељ светог Јована Претече.“ — the strange light began appearing **to Dionysius himself** every night on the place where he later raised the house, where the Romanian account has another man see it and go to the far-seeing hieromonk Dometius about it. „Цар му да и новац и повељу, која се и сад чува у манастиру.“ — the emperor gave him money **and a charter, which is kept in the monastery to this day**. „Но када једном разбојници морски опљачкаше обитељ, оде Дионисије поново у Трапезунт, и тамо сконча живот, у седамдесет другој години свога живота.“ gives the reason he went back to Trebizond as **sea robbers having plundered the house**, where saint.gr has him go to ask the emperor for help towards painting the church. „А манастир Дионисијат и до данас напредује и цвета.“, and the monastery of Dionysiou prospers and flowers to this day. **AND THE ICON, WHICH IS A DEDICATION AND AN ATTRIBUTION AND NEITHER IS A ROW.** „У том манастиру налази се икона Пресвете Богородице, названа Похвала, коју је цар Алексије Комнен даровао Дионисију.“ — in that monastery is the icon of the Most Holy Theotokos called Похвала, the Praise, which the emperor gave him — and „По предању, пред том је иконом први пут читан Акатист Богородици, састављен патријархом Сергијем.“, by tradition the Akathist to the Theotokos, composed by the patriarch Sergius, was read before that icon for the first time. **Three refusals in one sentence**: an icon is not a folder, a dedication is not a relation, and the attribution of the Akathist to a patriarch Sergius is this book’s own «По предању», by tradition, and not a claim this corpus makes. `grep -ho display_name saints/*/saint.json` returns nine multi-word Sergius folders and not one of them is a patriarch of Constantinople, so there is nobody to relate him to in any case. **`types` UNTOUCHED.** Преподобни is `venerable`, which the folder carries beside `abbot`. Ктитор in „Ктитор манастира Светог Јована (Дионисијата) на Атону.“ is a founder and is **not a rank word in this corpus’ vocabulary at all**; it is the thing the Greek line uses to name him, «κτήτορας της Μονής», and it goes in no field. No `office`: an abbot of his own foundation is not a see, and an `office` would have to be an English phrase the data already wrote down. **NO NEW `related` ROWS.** `dometius-disciple-of-dionysius` is already `related` here and the reciprocal is on that folder; this book does not name him, which is itself the difference recorded above, and the row is left exactly as it was. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse. THE VERSE IS NOT USED, AND ON THIS DAY IT IS THE HARDEST ONE YET TO LEAVE OUT. The ПЕСМА for 25 June is twenty-two lines on the first entry, and sixteen of them are a speech put in the martyr’s own mouth before her judge — cut, cut the feet, they have walked their road; cut, cut the hands, they have finished their work; and a warning that on the same day the two of them will go together before the Living God, he as torturer and she as the tortured. **It is Bishop Nikolai’s composition and not a word the entry reports her saying**, and a speech invented in verse is the easiest thing in this book to mistake for a source. §3 puts it in no field and in no life; it is recorded here and nothing of it is quoted as hers. The second entry gets no verse at all, which is the third day running that the verse treats one entry and ignores the rest.

hymns.text: Φῶς οὐράνιον, ἐν σοῖ σκηνώσαν, λύχνον ἄσβεστον, τοὶς ἐν τῷ Ἄθῳ, Διονύσιε σαφῶς σὲ ἀνέδειξε, σὺ γὰρ Προδρόμου τὸν βίον μιμούμενος, Μονὴν αὐτῶ ἀνεγείρεις περίβλεπτον. Πάτερ Ὅσιε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν ἱκέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ἠμὶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, the first of two apolytikia on his own page, Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως — it names him, «Διονύσιε», and names his monastery; the second apolytikion and the kontakion on the same page are the Forerunner's and are not taken

english.text: The heavenly light that made its dwelling in you showed you plainly as an unquenchable lamp to those on Athos, Dionysius; for imitating the life of the Forerunner you raised him a monastery to be gazed upon. Venerable father, entreat Christ our God to grant us great mercy.
